_comment: References the workspace's A/B + copy-fidelity gates compare against. tools/fetch-snapshots.mjs materializes these into .cache/snapshots/ (gitignored). A ref with a `bundle` field materializes from a committed local git bundle (durable, reproducible on clone); a ref with only `repo`+`sha` clones the remote at that SHA. The frozen sibling checkouts under /Users/jhp/code/jackhp95 remain read-only and are no longer the reference for these two.
_comment_elm_cem: elm-cem's generator forked AHEAD of upstream main (ad5d523) at the R-025 emitter change (D-045/D-046): M3e.Build.<X> now routes phantom types through the exposed M3e.Component.<X> surface. That change is workspace-only and un-upstreamed, so Face A (ab-elm-cem) can no longer compare against a remote SHA. The reference is now a committed git bundle of the workspace generator itself (post-change); Face A thus catches FUTURE accidental generator drift and forces a conscious re-baseline (re-bundle + bump sha) on any intended generator change. See D-046. RE-BASELINED at the component-merge + R-026 integration (L7): the bundle is a fresh `git archive HEAD:packages/elm-cem` of the COMBINED generator — component-ctor + R-025 re-applied + families layer + the R-026 opaque-Name gen-icon-module.js change — so Face A compares against the generator that actually ships on this branch (sha e5f2b9a8 -> 035b1852). This is the D-046 standing rule exercised for two intended, composed generator changes, not drift; both the standalone adopt-component and r026-icon-cap bundles are superseded because neither carried BOTH deltas. RE-BASELINED AGAIN (2026-08-18): the generator gained new `## Examples` doc emission (Toolbar/Tooltip/Tree/TreeItem/etc., driven by config/examples.generated.json growth) since the 035b1852 bundle; that snapshot never carried the Examples-emission code, so Face A was comparing against a stale generator, not the intended combined one. Fresh `git archive HEAD:packages/elm-cem` re-bundled (sha 035b1852 -> e8be491b), confirmed byte-identical A/B after re-baseline.
